g.text: Between the smaller varieties: almost nothing
Parallel sentence pairs between Iranic varieties
fas = Persian, kur = Kurdish, glk = Gilaki, mzn = Mazanderani, tly = Talysh, lki = Laki,
luz = S. Luri, hac = Gorani, diq = Zazaki, bal = Balochi
Translation between neighbours has to go through Persian or English.
